items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve heard they amazed the people in Europe how they used to play. And they had a trombone player named Archie, I can’t think of his name.

ctx.x: I’ve heard they amazed the people in Europe how they used to play. And they had a trombone player named Archie, I can’t think of his name. Anyway, he had a chance to join Duke Ellington’s band…everybody begged him to leave Columbus, OH and he would never leave. But he was fantastic.
Why didn’t he want to leave?
